title: Constitutional Law
shortDesc: High Court Writ Petitions, Fundamental Rights protection, Public Interest Litigation (PIL), and Judicial Reviews.
fullDesc: Representing individuals, corporations, and civil society in filing High Court Writ Petitions under Articles 199 & 184(3). Specializing in challenging unlawful administrative actions, fundamental rights violations, and statutory ultra vires actions.

title: Civil Litigation
shortDesc: Property partition, breach of contract, specific performance suits, declarations, and injunction proceedings.
fullDesc: Handling high-value civil suits, property disputes, contract enforcement, land title verification, specific performance, and tort actions across District and High Court levels.

title: Criminal Defense
shortDesc: High Court bail applications, criminal appeals, white-collar crime defense, and quashing of FIRs.
fullDesc: Providing defense counsel for high-profile criminal matters, pre-arrest and post-arrest bails, NAB financial offenses, cybercrime defense, and murder appeal hearings.

title: Corporate & Commercial
shortDesc: Mergers & acquisitions, shareholder litigation, commercial arbitration, and regulatory compliance.
fullDesc: Advising corporate boards, drafting cross-border commercial contracts, representing parties in international arbitration, shareholder dispute resolution, and regulatory compliance.

title: Property & Real Estate
shortDesc: Title perfection, leasehold disputes, commercial development contracts, and municipal planning challenges.
fullDesc: Full-service real estate legal counseling including title search verification, joint venture real estate contracts, land acquisition challenges, and tenant-landlord disputes.

title: Family & Inheritance
shortDesc: Estate succession planning, probate certification, custody matters, and marital property partition.
fullDesc: Compassionate yet assertive legal representation in family court proceedings, inheritance claims, distribution of inherited estates, probate execution, and guardianship petitions.
